resources.string: Care, one day at a time.
A little care starts with a record.
Keep your measurements and notes together, ready for your next conversation with a healthcare professional.
Records stay on this device. No account, advertisements, or automatic uploads.
This app records information. It does not measure your pulse, diagnose a condition, or monitor emergencies.
Keep a copy when you need one
Uninstalling or clearing app data deletes your records. Export reports before changing phones. Reports cannot be imported back in this version.
I understand what this app can and cannot do.
Record a measurement or how you are feeling. Your entries stay together here.
Add a reading from your device or a note about how you feel. There is no sample patient data in your journal.
The exported file contains your health information and is not encrypted by PusoAlalay. Choose a trusted location. It is only shared if you choose to share it.
The report could not be saved. Check the destination and try again. A partial file may need to be deleted.
User-entered records. Not a diagnosis or clinical assessment. All displayed dates and times are in Asia/Manila. No clinical normal ranges or risk scores are assigned.
Source: manually transcribed from a measuring device
For example: time, activity, device used, or how you felt.
All dates and times use Asia/Manila.
Copy the reading from your measuring device. This app does not measure it for you.
Enter a positive number up to 999. Use whole numbers for heart rate and blood pressure. These are entry limits, not healthy ranges.
Check the upper and lower numbers. Systolic must be higher than diastolic.
Choose a valid date and time that is not in the future.
Your unsaved changes will be lost.
This cannot be undone. Any exported copies will remain.
Could not save your changes. Your form is still here; please try again.
Your records could not be opened. They have not been deleted. Try again; do not clear app data or reinstall if you need to recover them.
Up to your 20 latest entries in this selection. Values are not classified as normal or abnormal. The full list is below.
Trend for %1$s, %2$d entries. First %3$s, latest %4$s. Each value is also listed below.
Choose a time to open your journal. This is a recording reminder, not a medication or emergency alarm.
Android may deliver reminders later to save battery. A reminder will not appear while the app is force-stopped; open the app again to resume.
A daily invitation to update your personal journal.
A moment for your journal. Add a record when you are ready.
Notifications are off. Allow them in Android settings to receive reminders.
Notifications were not allowed. You can enable them in Android settings.

Health values and notes are encrypted using an Android Keystore key. Record type and time remain in the local database. This app has no internet permission or analytics. Device security still matters.
Automatic backup and device transfer are disabled. Keep your phone locked. Export only when you need a separate copy; exported reports are readable files.
Screen capture is blocked to help protect your records.

The supplied October 2026 course paper compared a nearest-centroid classifier and a fixed rule on artificially altered pulse recordings. This experiment does not validate diagnosis, emergency detection, or wearable measurement accuracy.
Archived paper results: ML F1 0.7914; balanced accuracy 0.4909; specificity 0.1951. The rule had balanced accuracy 0.6006. These results were not rerun by this Android app.
No classifier is used on your personal records. Smartwatch import, live sensors, clinical alerts, and cloud synchronization are not included in this version.
All records on this device will be permanently deleted and reminders will be turned off. Reports already exported are not deleted.
All records deleted. Reminders are off.
The action could not be completed. Please try again.
